exclusions.reason: Build-time value: verter_lsp's build script embeds the build date (VERTER_BUILD_DATE) into every build of the package, and its server binary reports it, so every verter_lsp test binary depends on when it was built.

Build-time value: verter_bench's build script embeds the compiling checkout's commit, tree and dirty state (VERTER_BENCH_COMMIT_SHA, VERTER_BENCH_TREE_ID, VERTER_BENCH_DIRTY) into every build of the package.

Timing budget: the test code of this module or of a child module, or a test helper it calls, reads the clock for a budget, deadline or timeout (Instant or SystemTime reads, elapsed(), recv_timeout, wait_timeout, timeout futures, sleeps or Duration-bounded waits), so its outcome can depend on machine load. Each pattern covers the module and every module nested in it, including modules compiled only under a feature or on another platform.

Build-time value: the test code of this module or of a child module, or a test helper it calls, depends on the build-time path of a companion binary (env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_<name>"), directly or through verter_test_support's cargo_test_binary_path!), which it launches. Each pattern covers the module and every module nested in it, including modules compiled only under a feature or on another platform.
